left.title: Here Are The 81 People And Entities Close To Trump Democrats Are Investigating
left.body: The list includes Trump’s sons, Eric Trump and Donald Trump Jr., as well as his son-in-law, Jared Kushner.
left.roundup: House Democrats launched a broad probe into President Trump on Monday, requesting documents from 81 agencies and individuals as they investigate his business dealings, interactions with Russia, and possible obstruction of justice.
